titleEn: Create a discount coupon from the assistant

undo.note: The store has no delete call for the assistant; the owner switches the coupon off in the store admin

ar: عايز كود خصم 50 جنيه لمدة أسبوع
e3mel koboun khasm 10% le modet yom
en: Create a 10% discount coupon for one day

steps: Ask the assistant for a percentage (1 to 90) or fixed amount coupon, how long it lasts (max 90 days) and optionally a usage limit and a code
A card shows the code, discount, window and limit; nothing is created until you press confirm
On confirm the store creates the coupon through its own coupon service; a code is generated when you gave none
edgeCases: Percent above 90, a fixed amount above 50,000, a window over 90 days or an end before the start: no card is built
A code that already exists with different terms: refused, ask for another code (the same card pressed twice creates one coupon)
Coupons switched off in the store: refused with a clear reason
Staff and platform super-admin sessions: no card (owner only)
gaps: No screen yet: the assistant card is the flow, or the route
